dashmap_instances.name: subscriptions
dashmap_instances.migration_notes: Direct 1:1 API mapping. No breaking changes. Keep Vec<AlertRule> for immutable rules, keep RwLock<VecDeque> for history (cold path).

dashmap_instances.name: limiters
dashmap_instances.migration_notes: Direct 1:1 API mapping. get_or_create() pattern supported via entry() or direct insert.

dashmap_instances.name: responses
dashmap_instances.migration_notes: Keep CacheKeyCapsule array for LRU metadata. Only replace DashMap for response storage. No breaking changes.

rwlock_instances.name: sessions
rwlock_instances.migration_notes: Replace with LockfreeHashTable::new(8192). Remove .read()/.write() unwraps. Direct get()/insert() calls. Zero blocking.

rwlock_instances.name: forecasts
rwlock_instances.migration_notes: Cold path (analytics). Replace with LockfreeHashTable::new(4096). Keep capsule lockfree ops.

rwlock_instances.name: budgets
rwlock_instances.migration_notes: CRITICAL hot path. Replace with LockfreeHashTable::new(16384). Remove all .read()/.write() unwraps. get_or_create() becomes try_insert() + get() loop.

rwlock_instances.name: rules
rwlock_instances.migration_notes: Immutable after registration. RwLock acceptable for cold path. No contention.

rwlock_instances.name: history
rwlock_instances.migration_notes: LRU eviction, infrequent writes. RwLock acceptable for cold path. <300ns acceptable.

mutex_instances.name: file
mutex_instances.migration_notes: Replace with AsyncLogCapsule (batched writes). Requires feature = 'async-log'. Async writes, batching, <50ns append. See atomic_capsule::collections::async_log.

mutex_instances.name: stats
mutex_instances.migration_notes: Cold path statistics. Replace with StatsCapsule64. Atomic increment, record_latency, get_stats. Zero blocking.

mutex_instances.name: SharedResponse
mutex_instances.migration_notes: Coordinator-waiter pattern. Mutex semantics required (one writer, multiple readers). Not a hot path. Acceptable for coalescing coordination.

mutex_instances.name: payments
mutex_instances.migration_notes: Temporary store (KindlyDB in production). Replace with LockfreeHashTable::new(4096). Remove async mutex overhead.

tokio_broadcast_instances.name: tx (broadcast sender)
tokio_broadcast_instances.migration_notes: Replace with atomic_capsule::collections::channel(). Lossless guarantee (blocks sender when full). 5M+ msgs/sec, <500ns p99. See RingBufferBroadcast docs.
